p2g2.instruction: Complete the table using NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
p2g2.body: Century, Social Change in Britain, Reason, and Effect on Population table. Mid-17th century: Social change 'main drinks were still beer and ale (example)', Reason 'Imps helped to make beer last longer', Effect 'no significant change'. Late 17th century: Social change 'gin becomes more popular, especially with poor people', Reason 'beer becomes expensive because of [[19]]', Effect 'mortality rate goes up'. Early 18th century: Social change '[[20]] drinking starts to become widespread', Reason 'Britain starts trade with China', Effect 'mortality rate goes down'. Mid-18th century: Social change 'decline in urban deaths caused by [[21]]', Reason '[[22]] water used for tea and beer; antibacterial qualities of tannin', Effect 'infant mortality rate goes down by half'.
